## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Bug fix: a regression test fails without the fix (or the pull request says why not)
- [ ] `mix format`, `npm run lint` and the test suites pass
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (README, `docs/`), including `docs/security/`
      when an input or trust boundary changed
- [ ] UI changes include before and after screenshots, light and dark
- [ ] Prompt or validation changes include the evaluation summary (slice 09)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency in the extension
- [ ] User-facing changes are described for the changelog
